text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka keeps training for the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her body seems incapable of running continuously at top speed, and her leg has begun to hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Worried about her condition, Special Week suggests it may be best for her to withdraw from the upcoming Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Silence Suzuka doesn't give in to Special Week's plea, unyielding in her determination to run.
